# Maple HR Leave Policy

Maple leave benefits depend on employment type.

## Paid Time Off

### Full-Time Employees

Full-time employees receive 20 days of paid time off per calendar year, accruing monthly.

### Part-Time Employees

Part-time employees receive prorated PTO based on scheduled hours.

## Leave Requests

Submit leave requests in Workday at least 5 business days before the start date when possible.

## Cafeteria Hours

The Maple cafeteria serves breakfast from 8:00 to 10:00 and lunch from 11:30 to 13:30 on weekdays. This section is unrelated to leave entitlements.
